mettle.feedback.heavy_weapons.rhythm_of_: Rhythm of the Axe · next log +%s%%
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.armour_crusher: Heavy hits ignore 25%% of the target’s armour.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.berserker.desc: Below 40%% health you can’t be slowed or knocked back, and your heavy hits deal +40%% and heal you for a fifth of the damage.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.bone_breaker.d: Critical heavy hits slow the target by 40%% for 3 s.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.cleave.descrip: Axe hits spill 30%% of their damage onto every enemy beside the target.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.earthshaker.de: A mace smash, or a sneak-attack with any heavy weapon, slams the ground: every enemy within 4 blocks is thrown back and staggered for 1 s (10 s cooldown).
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.headhunter.des: Axe kills drop the mob’s head one time in five.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.headhunter.hin: Some trophies are taken, not found.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.heft.descripti: Axes, maces and tridents hit %s%% harder.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.iron_grip.desc: While you hold a heavy weapon nothing knocks you back, and you gain +2 armour toughness.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.log_hauler.des: Logs, planks and stripped wood weigh 40%% less for you.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.old_growth.des: Axes take no durability damage from chopping wood.
Jump crits with an axe or mace deal double damage instead of one and a half, and stagger the target for 0.5 s.
Taught by a city’s forester, or found in The Feller’s Rule.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.rhythm_of_the_: Each log you chop within 3 s of the last chops 15%% faster, up to +60%%.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.stagger.descri: Fully charged heavy hits interrupt the target: a creeper stops fusing, a skeleton loses its draw, and any mob misses its next attack.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.stonebreaker.d: A mace breaks stone, ore and deepslate as fast as an iron pickaxe, with the same drops.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.throwing_axe.d: Sneak and use an axe to throw it up to 16 blocks for a full-strength hit; it lies where it lands for you to pick up.
mettle.perk.heavy_weapons.timber.descrip: Sneak-chop the base of a tree to fell the whole trunk, up to 64 logs. Each log costs durability.
